outcomes.original: Estimated time: 0 to 0 days. Estimated government cost: $0 to $0. Notes: No timeline or cost is given because Planning Code §780.3(c)(1)(B) prohibits enlarging an existing restaurant space in the North Beach Special Use District, and the pathway analysis confirms the concept as described is not permitted at this address. The rule lines state that a new restaurant may be approved by Conditional Use only if the Zoning Administrator first finds the new restaurant will not enlarge the space, and the space is to be enlarged from 1,486 sq ft to 2,820 sq ft. The 2010 CUA (case 2009.0798C) approved expansion to over 2,000 sq ft, but no record in the candidate set since 2010 shows a restaurant square-footage expansion approved under this rule, and the current rule text does not provide an exception for existing restaurants. Until Planning confirms in writing whether any discretionary pathway exists, no application should be filed and no cost or timeline for approval can be estimated. If Planning confirms there is no approval path, the only options are to operate within the existing 1,486 sq ft footprint, seek a legislative amendment to the North Beach SUD, or choose a different location.
